name: hcapp_setDirectMessageMute
description: Mutes (silent pushes, the Silver Bell) or unmutes one direct-message thread for the caller (E9.F1.S7): writes HasherFriendMap.FriendNotificationPreference 3 (mute) or 0 (auto) on the caller's own row for @threadId. The other party is not told. Auth: device-bound token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 133, @param NULL); no permission gate beyond owning a HasherFriendMap row for the thread — a thread the caller is not party to is refused as 'No such conversation' (2008). Not transacted (a single UPDATE).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (ValidateAppAuth then fails gracefully).

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: The DM thread. Default NULL, which is refused with 2008. The column was added by the 2026-09-29 direct-messages script (db/hc6/app/archive) and is not yet in db/schema/tables/HC.HasherFriendMap.Table.sql.

parameters.name: mute
parameters.description: 1 mute (stored as 3), 0 normal (stored as 0). Default NULL — see code smells: NULL is not rejected and is written as 0.

rowsets.description: Auth failure (ValidateAppAuth) returns the error detail ALONE at index 0 and the SP returns — no envelope. Other failures return {success:0, errorCode, errorType} at index 0 and then this detail at index 1: 2008 'No such conversation' (errorType 2 — @threadId NULL, @mute not 0/1, or no HasherFriendMap row for the caller on that thread; logged to HC.ErrorLog), 2009 unhandled (errorType 5, CATCH, logged).

rowsets.name: Muted
rowsets.description: On success: echoes the request, not a re-read of the row.

columns.name: Muted
columns.description: @mute as passed (1 muted, 0 normal; NULL if NULL was passed).

sideEffects: UPDATE HC.HasherFriendMap SET FriendNotificationPreference = 3|0, updatedAt = SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() WHERE UserId = @userId AND ThreadId = @threadId (line 53).
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on refusal (line 44) and in the CATCH (line 61).

codeSmells.issue: NULL @mute slips past validation and unmutes
codeSmells.detail: Line 39: `@threadId IS NULL OR @mute NOT IN (0, 1) OR NOT EXISTS (...)`. With @mute NULL the middle term is UNKNOWN, so for a valid thread the whole predicate is UNKNOWN and the guard does not fire. Line 53 then writes CASE WHEN NULL = 1 ... ELSE 0 — the thread is silently unmuted and rowset 1 returns Muted = NULL. Add `@mute IS NULL OR` to the guard.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
